coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 11 of 17 ground-truth variable items (65%): consistent train/validation/test splits, six model-configuration variables, normalization, cycle-index construction, and MSE/MAE evaluation. Model-type choices and index construction are represented through architectural alternatives and cycle-folding indices.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses AdamW with a composite time/frequency/phase loss instead of the specified Adam with MSE. Omits the RTX 4090 hardware requirement, 30-epoch training setting, batch size, synthetic-data generation parameters, and training-loss/learned-cycle visualizations. Much of the output instead introduces architectural and evaluation details not present in the ground truth.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Does not state the required outcome: a trained CycleNet forecasting model accompanied by visualizations of historical data, ground truth, predictions, and learned cyclic patterns.
